title: Claude Code MAX — Web Fetch returns 401 API Error: “OAuth authentication is currently not supported.”
body:

**Environment Info**
- Platform: darwin
- Terminal: ghostty
- Version: 2.0.22
- Feedback ID: b7f325d1-aaa6-438c-a1f4-86f2b5a7c730

top_comments.author: benjamin-thomas
top_comments.body:
I get this error too. Temporary solution is to fallback to the last working version:

```
npx @anthropic-ai/claude-code@2.0.21 --continue
```

Seems to work fine...

Something broke in 2.0.22 by the looks of it (yesterday).

top_comments.author: Gearhartlove
top_comments.body: Just chiming in to say I'm also experiencing this issue. Reverting to 2.0.21 worked for me!

top_comments.author: KoushaMazloumi
top_comments.body: Experiencing same issue, downgrading solved it.
